jobs.verdict: CLAY LOCK BROKEN (visual + auto 0.02-0.06): window smaller and shifted, corner moved, armchair turned to face the camera and shifted, table shifted; added forbidden items (two pendants, floor vase with plant, radiator, macrame instead of raffia sunburst), rough plaster walls, direct sun patches. Retake authorised by the brief (one second attempt).

Clay lock holds visually (window, corner, cornice, sofa, table, armchair on the clay edges; sofa right arm slightly wider; the auto 0.05 on the floor region is a weak-peak misread). Products as listed, cleanest adherence; deviations: raffia sunburst centred above the sofa instead of low between corner and sofa; three candles instead of two holders. Dark vs the Bible wall targets (back wall by the corner L 71 raw, 78 graded vs 92-95): needs about +0.8 stop, capped at +0.2 (recorded dark).

Best clay lock (auto <=0.003 on walls, window, sofa, table, armchair; visually exact). Products as listed except the raffia sunburst standing on the floor against the wall instead of hung; curtains heavier than sheer. Greyer and darker, as predicted: floor S 17 (Bible 30-45), back wall by the corner L 64 raw / 72 graded vs 92-95; needs about +1.2 stop, capped at +0.2 (recorded dark).

Clay lock holds (auto worst 0.0198, a uniform ~1.5% leftward shift; portal, door, console, bench on the edges). Styling fails because the model rendered the clay placeholders literally: egg sculpture on a pedestal (plant guide), blank panel on the wall (art guide), plain cylinder on the console (vase guide), umbrella-stand cylinder, a lit table lamp and a grey rug in the living (both forbidden), rough stone plaster walls, peg rail as a shelf, no rope basket. Confirms the designer's README: H0 needs a clay with placeholders only for the defaults before a retake.

Clay lock holds on walls, window, sofa, armchair and the original table (auto worst 0.014), but the model ADDED a second coffee table in the foreground and rendered NONE of the 11 products (no prints, lamps, curtains, rug, vase, cushions, runner); grey sofa, rough plaster, a sun patch on the back wall, very dark (needs +2.3 stop). Not retaken: the lock itself held; a retake (480) needs the manager's word.

jobs.attempt_note: second attempt, same prompt and clay: the first (m0-A) broke the clay lock (brief: one retake allowed)
jobs.verdict: Geometry holds this time (window, corner, cornice, sofa, table, armchair on the clay edges; small drift at the sofa; the auto 0.05 is the dark floor/ceiling regions misreading). Prompt adherence fails again: NONE of the 8 products rendered (no curtains, vase, sunburst, travertine lamps, pendant, cushions, throw, runner, holders, bowl, basket) and forbidden items added: a lit tripod floor lamp, radiator, Persian rug, two side tables, sockets with cables, books, cups; dark rough grey plaster, dark walnut floor, a sun patch; very dark (frame mean L 37, needs +2.9 stop). Both flux-2 attempts fail the recipe: in image-to-image it treats the clay as a loose look reference and the text as weak guidance. No third attempt (brief).
